summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential data drops, build a recheck-and-act agent product (Lighthouse) with polling, extraction, approvals and routines, and prepare the demo, video and hand-in by 12:45 Sunday.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's launch plan said 'ok' while the Collector's Edition misses launch (overbooked art books, failed statues, packing speed), built and polished the Lighthouse app, merged teammates' branches, pushed main (08a119f) and set up a no-login demo at lighthouse.stenglein.dev. A scripted demo video recording was started, then stopped on request, with a final build and ship of the routines-line layout fix in progress.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) with no notifications or webhooks; the documented approach is polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, since files can be replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/; .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and is gitignored, while .env.example is committed.
The API does not load .env on import, so settings such as ASK_VIEWER_TITLE need a helper that loads .env first or they are missing after restart.

Demo instance runs from the Mac in tmux behind a Cloudflare tunnel; scripts/demo.sh supports restart and story (restore the prepared state) with ASK_DEMO_OPEN=on and ASK_DEMO_HOST=lighthouse.stenglein.dev.
Restarting the Cloudflare tunnel drops all hosts for about a minute; stopping it with Ctrl-C also closes its tmux session.
Case flow ('How we got here') lives on branch jonas/case-flow until merged; the team uses CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md workflow files.
The datacheck falsely reported a 'lost column' warning when a header was merely read with the wrong separator; it now ignores misread headers.

code.finding: The 'handled by your routines today' footer line was moved from the pinned bottom spot into the left column on desktop so it no longer covers the decision or flow; on phone it stays under the decision. Key hint badge '1' only shows when other options are open.

workflow: Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; sessions with no repo modifications log 'skipping checkpoint'.
Do not rebuild the web app while a recorder is reloading pages, since a mid-take build changes the video.
Interrupting a tool call mid-run can still let commits through; check git state after an interruption.
Measuring pixel positions of icon and text ink beats eyeballing for alignment fixes.
Use a subagent for long cross-checks (200 order confirmations, 59 scans) and for design variants, keeping the main session free.

friction: Portal token was initially empty, blocking the data pull until the user supplied it.
Tunnel restart via tmux failed on a wrong session name, taking all three hostnames down for about a minute.
Several UI iterations (phone layout, crowded top bar, flow spacing, logo centring) took repeated screenshot-and-adjust cycles close to the deadline.
Hand-in time moved from 12:00 to 12:45 unexpectedly and the Mac must stay awake and on power for the demo.
Background commit commands were interrupted by the user, leaving uncertainty about which commits landed.
The demo state had drifted (cases already decided at 12:04) and needed a reset before recording.
open_items: Finish the demo video: the recording was stopped, and the build with the routines-line fix still needs to be assembled and checked, with the demo state restored.
Live instance ask-soony.stenglein.dev still runs older server code and needs a restart for the sign-in choice, heartbeat and Senior Buyer title.
Deck for the hand-in was not confirmed as ready.
Routines page is messy with multiple routines; plan is a compact list with details on demand, a ⋯ menu and duplicate-merge hints.
'Send email, then chase once if no reply' routine step needs a follow-up watcher on replies.
All cases on phone as a bottom sheet, and a small preview of documents inside the flow, were deferred.
Move the demo off the laptop to ada if it needs to run unattended; the old Claude Docs doc still exists and the briefing page shows only the 14:00 state.
Boise EXW/DDP reply, Karton Nowak art book order, and sender address registration in the portal were not done by the agent.
